title: Federal Continuum of Care grants to San Francisco, 2015-2025
question: How much federal homeless-assistance money did San Francisco win each year, and for what?
finding: San Francisco's Continuum of Care awards rose from $30,968,697 in 2015 (59 projects) to $60,766,781 in 2025 (35 projects). Supportive housing's share fell from 87% to 79%. The FY2025 total agrees with the three FY2025 round totals already on disk.
how: The San Francisco (CA-501) block of HUD's California awards-by-component report for each year on disk; total is the grand total line, supportive housing the permanent supportive housing line.
limits: Awards are made a year or more before the money is spent. The 2015 and 2016 dashboard reports print only the planning grant under their total-award heading, so they are not used.
